miniapp.name: 我爱签名
miniapp.subtitle: 认真写下名字，也认真对待每一次确认。
miniapp.description: 已完成的微信手写签名小程序。支持自定义颜色与笔迹粗细、撤销重写和全屏书写；生成签名后可保存到相册。
features: 自定义颜色与笔迹粗细
miniapp.subtitleEn: A simple space for signatures that matter.
miniapp.descriptionEn: A completed WeChat mini program for handwritten signatures. Choose pen color and thickness, undo or start over, write full-screen, and save the finished signature to your photo album.

mobileTool.name: 时光工具助手
mobileTool.description: 把常用工具带到手机上，移动端版本正在开发中。
mobileTool.descriptionEn: A mobile companion for everyday tools. The iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS experience is in development.
